_comment: Power Plant (broken). The Manager is ready to blast somebody.
0: Somebody broke into the Power Plant...\nWhat is the WORLD comin' to?\fI blame phones.
1: I just got word from Cerulean.\nLooks like a shady character been\fhangin' around.\r
2: Could you help us out?\rThe shady character was hangin'\naround the Cerulean Block...\r
3: Could you help us out?\rThe shady character was hangin'\naround the Cerulean Block...
4: Somebody ran off with a part the generator\nNEED.\rWithout it, the new generator useless!\nIt's just a big metal box. A sad box.
5: This Power Plant was abandoned back in the\nday. Ghosts and all.\rWe got it back up to power the Magnet\nTrain. The ghosts still here though.
6: The Manager up ahead.\rBut since somebody wrecked the generator,\nhe been sad and, sometimes, FURIOUS...\rSometimes he just bust out laughin' outta\ndesperation. We been through SO much...\fHe ate a lightbulb yesterday.
7: The Magnet Train eat a LOTTA electricity.\rIt can't move if the generator ain't\nrunnin'. It's a hungry train.
8: I collect homies.\nYou got a DUGTRIO?\rWanna trade it for my MAGNETON? {YESNO 0}
9: Yesss! I got me a DUGTRIO!\nGood looks!
10: Huh? That ain't DUGTRIO.\nYou tried to finesse me...
12: Ayo, how my old MAGNETON doin'?
13: Manager: I-I-I'm ready to BLAST somebody!\rWho would STEAL a part outta my generator?!\rI spent YEARS fixin' it!\nIf I catch him, he gon' see what I can do\fwith my Power Bank! ZZZAP! *twitch*
14:
Manager: AH! YEAH!
That thing you got...That's the PART they stole from my BELOVED
generator?!You FOUND it?! Good looks! I'm cryin'!Now all I gotta do is...
put this part right here...
15: Manager: WHIRRRRRR!\rYES, it's RUNNIN'!\nWhirrr, whirrr! I'm whirrin' too!\r
16: Manager: WAHAH! Good looks!\rHere! Take this TM as a reward!\nIt's my baby! Treat it right!\r
17: Manager: TM57 is my Power Bank!\rIt shoot beams, and it can\nsometimes raise Special Attack!
18: Staff Mottos:\r1. Electricity ain't infinite.\n2. Save it wherever you can.\f3. Look out for each other.\f4. No standin' around.\f5. Wear shoes with rubber soles.\f6. The Manager is AWESOME.
19: Use electricity wisely\nfor a bright, good life.\f           Kanto Power Plant
